title: Patient Until the Coming of the Lord
summary: Like a farmer waiting for the rain, we wait patiently and work faithfully, strengthening our hearts for the sure return of Jesus.
exhortation: It can be difficult to be patient. But here we see that we're called to be patient until the coming of the Lord, which is a sure thing. We should look forward to that day and long for it. But like a farmer, we should wait with understanding, knowing that it's a process and that the Lord is the one doing it.

And we need to strengthen our hearts. It says, "Strengthen your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is near." How do we strengthen our hearts? We need to be people of the Word. We strengthen our hearts with the Word of God and his promises, reminding ourselves that his word is sure and will come to pass. Elsewhere Scripture says that not one of his words will fall to the ground.
And finally, we remind ourselves that Jesus will come. He will right every wrong. Justice and righteousness will reign in Christ when he comes. What a hope we have.
prayer: Lord, we eagerly await and anticipate your coming. But may we not be lazy, idling about. Your word speaks clearly against that. May we learn from the example of the farmer, who waits patiently for his crop to grow but works diligently and hard. Lord, you said the harvest is plentiful but the workers are few. So may we dive headfirst into your kingdom work and labor hard.

I pray for anyone who is discouraged about going to church and taking part in the life of Christian community. Perhaps they haven't gone back in a while. Maybe something happened, they were offended, and they lost their vision for being in God's community. I pray, Lord, that they would dive back in, full of faith again, to invest in others, to see others built up, and to grow in community. Lord, may we respond to this word and work hard like the farmer, eagerly anticipating, full of faith that you will return. Amen.
